nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Zero hunger|Food security|Addressing food deserts and inequalities_qna_000
nodes.question: What are some potential trade-offs associated with using smart solutions to address hunger issues in low-income countries?
nodes.answer: The uneven distribution of smart solutions could minimize the capacity to address hunger issues in low-income countries.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Zero hunger|Food security|Addressing food deserts and inequalities_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: In which region of the Netherlands were the intervention supermarkets located?
nodes.answer: The intervention supermarkets were located in the east part of the Netherlands.
nodes.paragraph: The intervention was devel - oped and proposed by the authors and finalised in col - laboration with the supermarket chain and the private organisation involved in the project. Supermarket selection The supermarkets where the intervention was imple - mented were located in the east-part of the Netherlands. The control supermarkets were matched by the retailer, based on three characteristics: compatible meat sales trends, compatible meat substitute sales trends, distance to nearest competitor in the area. The control supermar - kets were located in the west-part of the country. Ran - domisation was not feasible as the retailer was in charge of the supermarket selection, including which locations were allowed to be intervention locations. Intervention implementation and elements The intervention was implemented in the three interven - tion supermarkets in week 36 of 2022 and ran through week 48 of 2022. The fidelity of the intervention was monitored through weekly to bi-weekly contact with the supermarket managers of the intervention super - markets (i.e. images shared through text messages, con - tact by phone, and email). Additionally, members of the research team and employees from the private organisa - tion involved visited all three intervention supermarkets four times in total.

nodes.question: Why was randomization not feasible for the supermarket selection?
nodes.answer: Randomization was not feasible because the retailer was in charge of the supermarket selection, including the locations permitted for intervention.
